people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Rapha
people.line: Ancestor of Philistine giants; his descendants fought against David's warriors.

people.name: huge_man
people.line: A huge man from Gath, killed by David's warriors.

translations.web: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand, and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
translations.bsb: And there was also a battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
translations.kjv: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
translations.asv: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot; and he also was born unto the giant.
